_comment: Body measurement rules. Measurements are permanent body data (cm) kept separate from personality stats and styling. Metrics: height_cm, bust_cm, waist_cm, hips_cm, tone (0..1 muscle tone), bust_diff (bust - waist), hip_diff (hips - waist), curve_cm (average of both), fullness_cm ((bust + hips) / 2), frame (average circumference / height). 'render' maps metrics to renderer body-region parameters with piecewise-linear 'points' [metric, value]; the reference body (168 cm, 96/66/99) renders exactly like the original 'natural' variant, +10 cm bust like 'enhanced' and +7 cm hips like the BBL variant. 'tags' derive body appearance tags (0..1): each condition ramps from 'from' to 'to' and the tag is the product of its conditions. 'tag_bonus' feeds body tags into styling tags.
